notes.title: Baptism and circumcision
notes.intro: Paul links a spiritual circumcision with being buried with Christ in baptism.

views.label: Baptism is the new covenant sign, like circumcision, so it is given to children
views.summary: Reformed and other paedobaptist Christians see baptism replacing circumcision as the covenant sign, given to children of believers.

views.label: The new circumcision is of the heart, through faith
views.summary: Baptists stress that the circumcision Paul describes is spiritual and “through faith” (v. 12), so baptism is for believers.
